why_the_sign_test_does_not_rescue_it: p_exact_sign_test_on_discordant treats the 9/15 discordant PROMPTS as independent, which is the pseudo-replication this file's docstring exists to prevent: at L8 the 9 discordant prompts sit in 4 domains (one contributes 3); at L12, 5 of 15 share one domain.
what_remains: All point estimates are positive (+0.0081/+0.0141/+0.0222) and d_naive lies inside the ladder's own two-parameter family (R-27b), so this is at most a hint that effect depends on the complement rotation phi -- not evidence about direction meaning, and not significant.
